spec.explain: Toy illustration for arXiv 2106.09685: LoRA writes the update as two thin factors. Watch the trained number against the full number to see rank scaling.

questions.q: Set r to 4 and watch the factors. Do you expect a small rank to change only a few entries of W?
questions.why: misconception: low rank still updates every entry
